_meta.description: Static bridge file listing scheduled 2026 release dates from US and European institutions. Merged into the Calendar tab at render time. Sourced from official release calendars: Federal Reserve (FOMC), OMB Principal Federal Economic Indicators schedule (BLS/BEA/Census/Fed), ECB Governing Council calendar, and Bank of England MPC dates page. No editorializing — factual reporting only. Pipeline follow-up: ingest these calendars in the Python pipeline so this file can be regenerated weekly.

Finance Minister Brenda Bailey tabled Budget 2026-27 on February 17, 2026 — projects a $13.3B deficit, includes tax increases and 15,000 public sector job reductions over three years.

events.institution: Nova Scotia Department of Finance and Treasury Board
events.description: Finance Minister John Lohr tabled Budget 2026-27 "Defending Nova Scotia" on February 23, 2026. Forecasts a $1.2B deficit.
Finance Minister Nate Horner tabled the $83.9B 2026-27 budget on February 26, 2026, projecting a $9.4B deficit with no return to balanced budgets in the fiscal plan.

events.institution: New Brunswick Department of Finance and Treasury Board
events.description: Finance Minister René Legacy tabled Budget 2026-27 "Putting New Brunswickers First" on March 17, 2026.
Finance Minister Eric Girard tabled his eighth and final budget under Premier Legault on March 18, 2026. Pre-election budget with modest measures and a lower deficit projection.
Finance Minister Jim Reiter tabled the 2026-27 "Protecting Saskatchewan" budget on March 18, 2026. Projects a $819M deficit with spending increases alongside public service protection commitments.
Finance Minister Adrien Sala tabled the 2026 budget on March 24, 2026. Includes tax relief and affordability measures including removal of PST on groceries.

Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy tabled "A Plan to Protect Ontario" on March 26, 2026. Runs a deeper deficit and defers the return to balance. Presented as the most ambitious capital plan in Canadian history.
